<script lang="ts">

export type MessageSquareDotProps = IconProps<keyof typeof animations>;

export const animations = {

        rotate: 0,

      animate: {

    circle: {
      initial: {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
      },
      animate: {
        x: [0, -2, 0],
        y: [0, 2, 0],
        transition: {
          ease: 'easeInOut',
          duration: 0.6,
        },
      },
    },

<script setup lang="ts">

import { motion } from 'motion-v'

defineOptions({ name: 'MessageSquareDot', inheritAttrs: false })
